summary: Transient command prompt preceded delayed Leech Seed HP changes
symptom: game_battle_step returned verified at Birdlaw 15 / Sunflora 22; the next no-input observation changed to Birdlaw 10 / Sunflora 27 in battle_text

unexpected.predicted: A verified post-action command boundary must include all residual HP and recovery changes before returning
unexpected.actual: The two-sample 48-frame confirmation accepted a transient command signature before residual HP committed

authority.oracle: authoritative battle RAM must remain unchanged through the complete command-boundary settling window
sources: battle RAM HP, species, PP, menu state, and text ownership

steps: Present a command menu whose authoritative HP changes only on the third 24-frame settling sample.
Require advance_battle_until_menu to reject the transient signature and return only the settled HP.
reproduction.observed: The prior two-sample implementation returned before the third-sample HP delta; the five-sample implementation returns HP 5 in both runs.

root_cause.claim: The shared command-boundary verifier sampled only 48 frames, while Run & Bun can render a transient command menu before delayed residual HP and recovery effects commit.
evidence: A Gavi clone returned Birdlaw 15 / Sunflora 22, then changed without input to Birdlaw 10 / Sunflora 27.
The synthetic RAM fixture reproduces the third-sample state delta and fails under the former two-sample loop.
Five 24-frame samples produced stable post-residual boundaries throughout two complete 23-action Gavi wins.
alternatives_falsified: No extra controller input occurred between the verified return and the no-input RAM observation.
The HP deltas match Leech Seed damage and recovery, not stale party decoding.

solution.contract_change: A command-menu result now requires five consecutive 24-frame authoritative settling samples, covering delayed residual effects without host idling.

targeted_checks.name: delayed residual command boundary
targeted_checks.evidence: 1 test passed; settled HP is returned after the third-sample delta

replay.expected: No post-return autonomous battle delta and a terminal win under the certified Croakatoa policy.
replay.actual: Two complete 23-action cartridge-clone replays ended in victory with every returned boundary stable under no-input observation.

domain_knowledge: Leech Seed and similar residual effects may commit after a transient command prompt is rendered.
tooling_contracts: Never certify a Run & Bun command boundary until HP, species, PP, menu state, and text ownership remain stable through the full settling window.
